en: Return to the title screen? Unsaved progress will be lost.
zh: 未保存的进度会丢失。确定返回标题画面？

keys: Talk to the guide near the spawn point.
en: Talk to the guide near the spawn point.
zh: 和出生点附近的向导交谈。

keys: Welcome. This plane is yours to build on.
en: Welcome. This plane is yours to build on.
zh: 欢迎。这片场地随你搭建。

keys: WASD to move Shift to run Space to strike. Edit data/content to add quests and dialogue.
en: WASD to move Shift to run Space to strike. Edit data/content to add quests and dialogue.
zh: WASD 移动，Shift 奔跑，Space 攻击。编辑 data/content 添加任务和对话。

keys: Pod 07. The lid is half open. Frost on the glass. The status screen still reads: OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE. There is no one inside.
en: Pod 07. The lid is half open. Frost on the glass. The status screen still reads: OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE. There is no one inside.
zh: 07 号休眠舱。舱盖半开，玻璃上有一层霜。状态屏还亮着：OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE。舱里没有人。

keys: Pod 07... that should be Security Officer Vale.
en: Pod 07... that should be Security Officer Vale.
zh: 07 号舱……应该是安全官 Vale。

keys: ...At least, that's what the manifest says.
en: ...At least, that's what the manifest says.

keys: Why does the screen still say occupied?
en: Why does the screen still say occupied?
zh: 为什么状态屏还显示有人？

keys: You know what happened, don't you?
en: You know what happened, don't you?
zh: 你知道发生了什么，对吗？

keys: Let me take a closer look.
en: Let me take a closer look.

keys: No exit record. At least, not in my copy.
en: No exit record. At least, not in my copy.
zh: 没有离舱记录。至少，我这里没有。

keys: If there is, it's in a section I can't read right now.
en: If there is, it's in a section I can't read right now.
zh: 如果有，也在我现在读不到的舱段里。

keys: The manifest wasn't updated. Or someone changed it.
en: The manifest wasn't updated. Or someone changed it.
zh: 名单没有更新。或者，有人改过它。

keys: Someone with access. Or someone who didn't need it.
en: Someone with access. Or someone who didn't need it.
zh: 有权限的人。或者，不需要权限的人。

keys: I know as much as you do, Commander. And right now... I can't read that record.
en: I know as much as you do, Commander. And right now... I can't read that record.
zh: 我知道的和你知道的一样多，指挥官。而且我现在……读不到那段记录。

keys: Is this connected to the fleet link?
en: Is this connected to the fleet link?

keys: My memory is incomplete. Some records weren't damaged. They were taken.
en: My memory is incomplete. Some records weren't damaged. They were taken.
zh: 我的记忆不完整。有些记录不是损坏，是被人拿走了。

keys: I don't know. When the power is back, I'll look.
en: I don't know. When the power is back, I'll look.
zh: 我不知道。等电力恢复，我会查。

keys: The fleet link was cut before we dropped out. It wasn't a natural failure.
en: The fleet link was cut before we dropped out. It wasn't a natural failure.
zh: 舰队连接在脱离前就断了。不是自然中断。

keys: ...I can't be sure. Don't make me guess, Commander.
en: ...I can't be sure. Don't make me guess, Commander.
zh: ……我不能确定。别让我猜，指挥官。

keys: What do you want to check?
en: What do you want to check?

keys: The glass is cracked from the inside. The emergency release is broken too. It was forced inward.
en: The glass is cracked from the inside. The emergency release is broken too. It was forced inward.
zh: 玻璃是从里面裂开的。应急释放装置也坏了，方向朝内。

keys: Someone woke up inside and forced the pod open. But the system has no record of a wake-up.
en: Someone woke up inside and forced the pod open. But the system has no record of a wake-up.
zh: 有人在里面醒来，然后强行打开了舱。但系统没有记录这次唤醒。

keys: The status screen keeps repeating: OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE.
en: The status screen keeps repeating: OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE.
zh: 状态屏还在重复：OCCUPIED / LIFE SIGNS: NONE。

keys: It's still waiting for someone who isn't there.
en: It's still waiting for someone who isn't there.
zh: 它还在等一个已经不在的人。

keys: The locker is open. An empty security holster. A data chip on the floor.
en: The locker is open. An empty security holster. A data chip on the floor.
zh: 储物柜开着。空的安全官枪套。地上有一枚数据芯片。

keys: The locker is empty now. Only the holster is left.
en: The locker is empty now. Only the holster is left.
zh: 储物柜已经空了。只剩下枪套。

keys: The chip is safer with you.
en: The chip is safer with you.

keys: Pod 07's personal log. Take it. Don't open it now.
en: Pod 07's personal log. Take it. Don't open it now.
zh: 07 号舱的个人记录。拿走它。现在别打开。

keys: You pick up the data chip.
en: You pick up the data chip.

keys: When I have more power, I might be able to read it. Opening it now could burn it.
en: When I have more power, I might be able to read it. Opening it now could burn it.
zh: 等我恢复算力，也许能读。现在打开，可能会烧掉它。

keys: The maintenance panel is locked. It needs power.
en: The maintenance panel is locked. It needs power.
zh: 维护面板锁死。需要电力。

keys: Forcing it now would destroy the records inside. Power first, Commander.
en: Forcing it now would destroy the records inside. Power first, Commander.
zh: 现在强行打开，只会毁掉里面的记录。先修电，指挥官。

keys: ...All right. But don't touch that pod.
en: ...All right. But don't touch that pod.

keys: Let's go. Power first. ...I'll keep looking.
en: Let's go. Power first. ...I'll keep looking.
zh: 走吧。修电要紧。……我会继续查。

keys: Commander, about Pod 07. I've read a little more.
en: Commander, about Pod 07. I've read a little more.
zh: 指挥官，关于 07 号舱——我读到一点了。

keys: Pod 07 is empty. I haven't finished checking. You should see it when you pass through.
en: Pod 07 is empty. I haven't finished checking. You should see it when you pass through.
zh: 07 号舱是空的。我还没查完。你路过时可以看看。

keys: It was manually awakened eleven hours before the crash. The wake command came from inside the ship, not the bridge.
en: It was manually awakened eleven hours before the crash. The wake command came from inside the ship, not the bridge.
zh: 它在迫降前十一小时被手动唤醒。唤醒指令来自船内，不是舰桥。

keys: After that, the record cuts off.
en: After that, the record cuts off.

keys: I don't know. Or... I'm not sure I should tell you yet.
en: I don't know. Or... I'm not sure I should tell you yet.
zh: 我不知道。或者……我不确定现在该不该告诉你。

keys: Are you protecting me, or yourself?
en: Are you protecting me, or yourself?
zh: 你是在保护我，还是保护你自己？

keys: No life signs. But no body, either.
en: No life signs. But no body, either.
zh: 没有生命信号。但也没有尸体。

keys: Power first. When I can read more, I'll tell you.
en: Power first. When I can read more, I'll tell you.
zh: 先修电。等我能读到更多，我会告诉你。

keys: The data chip wakes on the analysis table. Vale's voice is broken by static.
en: The data chip wakes on the analysis table. Vale's voice is broken by static.
zh: 数据芯片在分析台上亮起。Vale 的声音断断续续。

keys: If anyone hears this: they cut the fleet link. It wasn't an accident.
en: If anyone hears this: they cut the fleet link. It wasn't an accident.
zh: 如果有人听到这段记录：他们切断了舰队连接。不是意外。

keys: I tried to stop them. If I failed, don't trust the manifest.
en: I tried to stop them. If I failed, don't trust the manifest.
zh: 我试着阻止他们。如果我失败了，别相信名单。

keys: ...That's Vale's voice. Vale was alive when this was recorded. At least then.
en: ...That's Vale's voice. Vale was alive when this was recorded. At least then.
zh: ……这是 Vale 的声音。录这段话的时候，Vale 还活着。至少那时候还活着。

keys: If Vale is still on this ship, we will.
en: If Vale is still on this ship, we will.
zh: 如果 Vale 还在这艘船上，我们会的。
你该吃点东西了，指挥官。

keys: All requirements met. We can try waking the geneticist.
en: All requirements met. We can try waking the geneticist.
zh: 条件都满足了。可以尝试唤醒基因专家。

keys: Shelter built. We have a roof.
en: Shelter built. We have a roof.
zh: 简易房屋建好了。我们有屋顶了。

keys: Thermal generator online. The ship is charging.
en: Thermal generator online. The ship is charging.
zh: 热能发电机上线。飞船正在充电。
